model_use_note: Use before buying a qualifying rod or whenever no consumable is equipped; bait leaves bite-waiting time unchanged.
Standard Bait is consumed once per cast and halves bite-waiting time.
Spinner may be used without bait and wears only on a fish nibble.
Standard Bait halves bite-waiting time and one Spinner is equipped.
Dressed Spinner may be used without bait and wears only on a fish nibble.
Standard Bait halves bite-waiting time and one Dressed Spinner is equipped.
